title: Azusawa Kohane — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kohane's birthday
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
Good work on the event today, guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm glad we managed another win.
Still... It feels so strange that it's still light out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The events we join tend to start around sundown, so it's usually dark by the time we're done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. Finishing early like this should give us extra time for practice today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're right... Though, I do kind of wish we could see more of Yokohama since we came all this way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe, I get that. The weather's so nice too!
And the sea breeze feels great.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, sorry about the wait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Dad! Thanks for driving!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now we'll have a debrief on the drive home like usual, and then we can practice at Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: About that... I've got a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Today's your birthday, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Your event wrapped up early in the day, and you've got time to spare. The stars are aligned here, so how about doing some sightseeing for a change?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, sightseeing...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that alright?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sure thing. Though, sorry to say I've got plans after this. We'll only be able to stick around for two hours or so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Even that's huge!
Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, breaks are important too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Let's accept Ken's kind offer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, where do we go?!
Actually, I don't know much about Yokohama...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me, Azusawa, you came here for your school trip last year, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Where did you go at that time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so, my group went around the Chinatown.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But this area... We didn't make it here to Minato Mirai, so I kind of want to see it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's your birthday, so why not? We can just head where you wanna go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, agreed!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, guys!
Then, first...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That event just ended, so no one's blaming you.
Whatever comes next, first is filling our stomachs.
Seafood Restaurant

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait. I have five Daily Special Seafood Bowls, one with no squid.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa... Tuna, salmon, scallops, shrimp... It's all gigantic.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken... Are you sure about treating us to such lavish seafood?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
It'd be wrong not to have some good food while you're here to see the sights.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...!
Then, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Mm...!
This scallop sashimi, it has such a sweet flavor to it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh, looks like this vintage clothing shop specializes in Americana. They've got some pretty unusual items, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, look here! This fleece jacket would totally look great on you, Kohane! It's big and baggy, but not that long, so it's got a cool/cute vibe to it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? A-Are you sure?
I don't think I'm ready to start wearing vintage yet...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've come all this way. Shouldn't you take this chance to try something on?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What he said!
It's your birthday, so you get to act a little more grown up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there's one of the staff!
Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry about this, but I'll be stepping away for a bit to check something I've been curious about. You all go on without me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sure! Understood.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you later, Dad! And thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was pretty fun seeing all those trendy shops!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. And... It was also fun feeling like I was on a field trip with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
I mean, it's not like we've done much sightseeing together before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Kohane, everybody, is now a good time?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku?
Yeah, now is fine. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Today's your birthday, isn't it, Kohane? We were talking about having a party at Crase Cafe, and came to ask if you have any free time...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But are you still out at your event destination?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We are. Our event today was here in Yokohama, and we've stuck around to do some sightseeing at Ken's kind suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wait, sightseeing?! I'm so jealous, that sounds really fun!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <This is a great spot with that view of the water!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, be sure to relax and recover from all that hard work at the event!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We will! And we'll go visit you all tonight with souvenirs.
I'm looking forward to the party too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks, and glad to hear it. Well then, we'll get things ready until you guys come over.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we'll grab them some souvenirs real quick before we go... But we don't have much time left. What should we do next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, there's a place I really want to visit with all of you before we finish for today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A place you want to visit...?
